name: MMTToolForDevice
summary: Identify the iOS device model, screen size and type at runtime.
description:
MMTToolForDevice is a lightweight, dependency-free Swift library for identifying
 the iOS device your app is running on. It maps the hardware machine identifier
 (e.g. "iPhone16,1") to a readable model, screen size and device type, and stays
 up to date with the latest iPhone, iPad and iPod touch models.
